text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(My body's holding up! My legs are holding 
up! My head has never been this clear!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I can tell! How hard that "one 
last step to catch up" really is! And the 
difference in our strength...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(—Still, I want to win! That's why I want 
to beat them! Spe-chan! And King-chan 
too—!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(...At that moment, I felt like my eyes 
met Sei-chan's for a split second.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
O-Oooo, ooooooh, oooooooooooh! Like I'd 
ever loooooooose!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I ran with all my might! I raced with 
everything I had!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (Even so――!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh... I lost...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Haha... My whole body is shaking too...! 
Seriously, everyone is... so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(My face is burning hot. Even deep in my 
eyes, it burns. Even the sweat tracing 
down the bridge of my nose feels scorching 
hot—)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(—I found myself thinking once more that I 
want to win next time.)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone is so amazing.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And Tsuru-chan has grown so much too...! 
I'm sure she kept working super hard after 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's so amazing...! She's trying so 
hard...! I have to fire myself up even 
more...!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Why not just leave the clapping to the 
audience?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Someone who is first-rate minds their 
manners.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, right now, the race just finished, 
didn't it?! And this was the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown, too."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If you feel like things didn't go the way 
you wanted, ...it's okay to bite your lip 
in frustration, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, well. What should Sei-chan do~? The 
same trick won't work twice. Should I 
switch up my tactics――

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: —Should I switch prey?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru-saaan. I'm gonna give it a quick 
spritz with cooling spray, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ah, —yes! I'd be glad to!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah!? Did I do it again... I'm so 
sorry! Um...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It just hasn't really sunk in yet.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Even after running the whole 
Kikuka-sho... you're both standing so 
firmly and able to converse like this."
choice_data_list:
It just shows how much stronger you've 
become.

It just shows how much stronger you've 
become.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ......Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ……"Absolute", right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...So, I was able to run in the Triple 
Crown races after all.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Trainer. You're up right after 
me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I want to run much, much more. To see just 
how far the me who ran today can go next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race really drove it home for me. 
Just how strong my generation is. But—"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"—Right now, I just desperately want to 
believe that the day might come when I can 
surpass my peers!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
That is why I want to head for the Tenno 
Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If you want to become an Umamusume who can 
beat any opponent, you've got to run in 
the Tenno Sho (Spring), just like 
President Rudolf did!
choice_data_list:
So that's the challenge you want to take 
on, Tsuyoshi?

So you want to take on that challenge, 
Tsuyoshi?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...Are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, the distance might pose some 
difficulties. But she is the one who can 
overcome that.
choice_data_list: I bet Tsuyoshi could pull it off
I bet Tsuyoshi could pull it off, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next goal was decided to be 
the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
